entries.name: The God-Emperor
entries.content:
The Emperor of Mankind, presently known as the God-Emperor or simply The Emperor, is an enigmatic man who led humanity across the starts and settled millions of worlds in this fictional rendition of the Milky Way.

An event known as the Horus Heresy led to the Emperor being entombed and martyred on the Golden Throne of Terra. Now merely a barely living carcass, the Emperor sits undying on his throne, powering a device known as the Astronomicon. This device allows humanity to travel faster than light utilizing the Warp. However the Emperor is slowly dying and when he dies, all of humanity will be stranded on millions of worlds for their enemies to destroy. The second the Emperor dies, humanity is doomed. And so he is fed a thousand souls each day so that he may never truly die.

entries.name: The Eccliesiarchy
entries.content:
The Eccliesiarchy is a church that venerates the Emperor as the God of Mankind. The Eccliesiarchy is bound under an agreement that they may have no "men at arms" and so their private army exists in a loophole by being entirely female. These sisters are referred to as the Sisters of Battle or the Adepta Sororitas.

The Adepta Sororitas are zealous, nigh-psychotic worshippers of the God-Emperor. They will torture, maim, kill and burn anything that threatens their worship and faith. They are so extraordinarily faithful that even demons struggle to possess them and when demons do, sisters will often torture the possessed in a sick game of exorcism. To the Sisters of Battle the xeno (the word for non-human aliens) and heretic alike are worth nothing except to be burned by the, sometimes literal, fire of their faith. They do burninf at the stake, torture, witch hunts, every conceivable horrible thing a religion has done, the sisters of battle will do in spades in the name of the God-Emperor.

entries.name: Warhammer 40K
entries.content:
The universe of Warhammer 40K is a science-fantasy, space-faring universe with the simultaneous existence of magic and science.

Humanity, referred to as the Imperium of Man, is a xenophobic empire in that it exterminates or enslaves any intelligent, non-human life.

It is a fascist, zealot regime in that there is no freedom of speech or religion. Any who defy the veneration of the God-Emperor is a filthy heretic and deserves nothing but torture as penance before being granted death.

Humanity is a space-faring civilization only thanks to the undeath of their Emperor, who sits on the Golden Throne as a rotting carcass barely alive. He powers a device called the Astronomicon which enables travel between star systems. The second he dies, a legion of demons attack all of humanity across millions of worlds and no travel or aid will arrive to save them.
